profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs youth soccer programs through volunteer-led local regions in communities across the United States. Founded in 1964, it describes its approach around principles such as everyone plays, balanced teams and positive coaching.

review.notes: The cited sources confirm AYSO's national nonprofit (Torrance, EIN 95-6205398) exists, but none link it to OUSD, and AYSO's own site shows only volunteer-run community regions with no school or after-school programming. The agenda name is plural ('Organizations'), so the Torrance match alone is too weak to rule out a different or local entity.
